heading: Travel with local experts you can trust
description: Based in the Himalayas of Himachal Pradesh, India Escapes creates authentic journeys backed by genuine local expertise.  Trusted by travellers from the UK, Australia, South Africa, Europe, and North America, we provide honest advice, dedicated support, and carefully crafted itineraries designed from first-hand knowledge. We are associated with recognised tourism organisations, including Travel for LiFE (India Tourism), the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Himachal Pradesh Tourism, and are trusted through leading global travel platforms such as TripAdvisor, TourRadar, GetYourGuide, and WeTravel. With a 4.8/5 traveller rating on TripAdvisor, India Escapes combines local expertise, trusted partnerships, and personalised service to help you experience India with confidence.
